bucket_note: Verified: no agency-published record-level crash data (NH state ArcGIS org, NHDOT GIS snapshots on GRANIT, NHDOT GIS Data Catalog). Records sit in NH DMV VISION under RSA 260:14; NHDOT shares located snapshots with RPCs only.

sources.name: NH DMV VISION crash records / NHDOT GIS crash layer (request)
sources.access: records request (RSA 260:14; bulk: Saf-C 5602, form DSMV 494)
sources.licence_quote: records released on "representation ... that the use of the records will be strictly limited to" listed uses, incl. "use by a legitimate business in research activities, and ... in statistical reports, so long as personal information is not disclosed" (RSA 260:14)
sources.street_names_share: not measured statewide (UVLSRPC re-host: 0.8409 with a cross street)

blockers: RSA 260:14 limits release to listed uses; no paid-use grant
re-hosts are stale (UVLSRPC to 2017) or one corridor (RT114) and carry no grant
user_actions: Ask NHDOT (GISMaps@dot.nh.gov / crash data analyst) for one county-year sample in its GIS crash layout, with written permission for paid use
If routed to NH DMV: bulk request under RSA 260:14 / Saf-C 5602 (DSMV 494) for research/statistical use without personal information
Re-check in 2027 for NH OHS's planned public crash portal
